name: Update streak stats

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"        # setiap 5 menit
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/streak-stats.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    # ✅ Anti-loop: skip kalau commit pemicu mengandung [skip ci]
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate streak stats
        uses: DenverCoder1/github-readme-streak-stats@main
        with:
          options: user=${{ github.repository_owner }}&theme=radical&hide_border=false&fire=ffff00
          path: dist/streak-stats.svg
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit & push
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.name "RusdiEneri"
          git config user.email "nuruddinrusydiilham@gmail.com"

          # ✅ Timestamp → file selalu berbeda tiap run
          echo "<!-- generated: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) -->" >> dist/streak-stats.svg

          git add dist/streak-stats.svg

          # ✅ Cek apakah benar-benar ada perubahan sebelum commit
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit, skipping."
            exit 0
          fi

          # ✅ [skip ci] → mencegah loop dari trigger push
          git commit -m "chore: update streak stats [skip ci]"

          # ✅ Pull rebase untuk menghindari race condition
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
